comments.body: A formality that EIP 7870 is out of the review period and will become "live" from an EIP status point of view, if no objections  -- we can then link to this ACD session when changing it from "in review" to "live"

H-star upgrade needs a name. 
Ideally have a name set by Fusaka going live on mainnet. (assuming that next couple of ACDC calls are fairly quiet).
